title: Blinkit ko mera Wi-Fi ka naam kaise pata?
topic: Blinkit app teardown (25-27 Nov 2026): Wi-Fi name + location, claim vs reply, 4-step privacy checklist
world: Wi-Fi ka naam = ghar ka address

experiment.change: A same-day viral controversy told with BOTH sides (her claim vs Blinkit's reply, status stated exactly) instead of an evergreen explainer
experiment.why: Ep3 and devmonk's 8.3M UPI reel were the same topic, so freshness and 'send to a friend' matter. A story people already argue about in comments gets shared

hooks: Dialogue cliffhanger: Intern: 'Bhaiya, Blinkit ko mere Wi-Fi ka naam pata hai!'
Absurd question: 'Bina GPS ke Blinkit ko kaise pata tum kahan ho?'
Lived moment: 'Raat 12 baje, Blinkit se chips mangaye. App ne kya kya dekha?'

caption:
Comment PRIVACY for phone privacy checklist, ek page mein. DM mein bhejta hoon.

Blinkit ko tumhare Wi-Fi ka naam pata hai? Ek creator ne app ka code khola aur ye daava kiya. Blinkit ka jawab bhi aaya. Dono side yahan hain.

Us dost ko bhejo jo roz Blinkit se mangata hai.

Status: ye creator ka daava hai, Digit ne ise independently verify nahi kiya. Blinkit ne kaha ye performance ke liye hai, marketing ya households pehchanne ke liye nahi.

Tumhara kaam: location sirf app chalte time, ads ID delete, Wi-Fi ka naam badlo, permissions check karo.

Quiz: kaun sa Wi-Fi naam sabse risky? A, B ya C? Comment karo, answer pinned comment mein.

Save karo, kaam aayega.
